notes: Fixes the actual Chat YouTube Companion pairing routing bug in extension 1.0.5. Chrome includes sender.tab when the extension options page is open as a normal tab. Older workers treated any message with sender.tab as YouTube content-script traffic, rejected the extension-page origin, and returned no response, causing ‘The message port closed before a response was received’. The worker now identifies its options/popup pages by its own chrome-extension URL instead. Regression tests cover a tabbed options sender and a YouTube content-script sender. Update Chat, load companion 1.0.5, generate a fresh token, and pair again.
